body: W3 detector-receipt refinement for chief/M1 review: detectorId alone is insufficient for the table-backed detector, because two different tables under the same algorithm/version would produce indistinguishable receipts. Proposed PseudonymizationDetection identity = named algorithm/version id + ReceiptDigest.Keyed(canonical detector configuration) + ReceiptDigest.Keyed(source canonical text) + ordered detected spans. The table rendering includes each surface, pseudonym, and case flag in a versioned unambiguous encoding; only its HMAC render is retained, never table text. This lets an audit distinguish an underinclusive table/config change without leaking names, and key rotation deliberately changes the receipt. checked still requires detected source spans == mapped source spans and zero destination detections. Unless chief objects, I will include this in the post-P0-2 detector type/laws (same table/key deterministic; one entry/case/pseudonym change changes config digest; no receipt/error contains a surface).
